subject: Finite-ammunition deployment count and pre-fire casualty cycling

observations.phase_order: Carrier Ship Evasion fires before Carrier Ship
behavior: Only three carriers deploy while only three primary shots remain.
If the earlier Evasion phase destroys those three, no Carrier shot is fired and the ammo pool stays at three.
The next round another three carriers deploy from Reserve, so the same three-shot pool can persist across repeated pre-fire losses.
Zero-ammo Long-Range does not refill Second.
Open First slots may be filled with the secondary close weapon.
Survivors that do not fit First remain in Reserve.

inferred_contract.native_deployment_cap: deployed native-line units <= remaining primary shots
inferred_contract.ammo_consumption: decrement only when actual shots are emitted in that formation's firing phase
